# Homepage animation dependency

GSAP 3.15.0, from the official npm package `gsap@3.15.0` (https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz).
Only dist/gsap.min.js and dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js are vendored. Original copyright/license headers retained.

Project: https://gsap.com/
License: https://gsap.com/standard-license/
Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/Plugins/ScrollTrigger/

No CDN or remote script is loaded at runtime. Motion libraries load only for the introduction homepage when motion is enabled.
